edit.statement: The daytime sky is blue because air molecules scatter blue sunlight more than red (Rayleigh scattering).
edit.subject: The blue colour of Earth's daytime sky
edit.object: Rayleigh scattering of sunlight by air molecules
premises: Air molecules scatter short, blue wavelengths of sunlight much more strongly than long, red ones.
